007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.RunTeamRequest;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TeamRunResult;
014
015/**
016 * Runs a team granted to the current database user by another team owner.
017 *
018 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD}, and
019 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL} for the consumer account. Set
020 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_SHARED_TEAM_NAME} to an owner-qualified name such as
021 * {@code TEAM_OWNER.SHARED_SUPPORT_TEAM}, and set
022 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_PROMPT} to a prompt appropriate for that team.
023 * The team owner must already have granted the consumer run access using
024 * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT.GRANT_TEAM_ACCESS}. The consumer also needs
025 * privileges and access to resources used by the workflow.</p>
026 *
027 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_CONVERSATION_ID} to the ID of an existing
028 * database conversation created with
029 * {@link com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation#create()}; an arbitrary
030 * UUID is not sufficient. Reuse it when responding to a team run waiting for
031 * human input, even when the next call uses another connection.
032 * This example runs the team directly without loading a {@code Team} handle
033 * from the owner's metadata view.</p>
034 */
035public final class RunSharedTeamSample {
036
037    private RunSharedTeamSample() {
038    }
039
040    /**
041     * Runs a granted team and prints its returned result.
042     *
043     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
044     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
045     */
046    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
047        String teamName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_SHARED_TEAM_NAME");
048        RunTeamRequest request = RunTeamRequest.builder()
049                .userPrompt(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_PROMPT"))
050                .conversationId(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_CONVERSATION_ID"))
051                .build();
052        try (SelectAIAgent client = SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
053                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
054                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
055                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
056                .build())) {
057            TeamRunResult result = client.runTeam(teamName, request);
058            System.out.println(result.getRawValue());
059        }
060    }
061
062    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
063        String value = System.getenv(name);
064        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
065            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
066        }
067        return value;
068    }
069
070}
